I, Gayantha Karunatilake, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed fora public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of thatAct Such Servitude is to be acquired from which lands are describedbelow.
1. Description of Servitude - For the construction at access toKumbukkana Intake of Monaragala - Buttala Integrated water SupplyProject.

2. Description of the land - Three (03) allotments of landcontaining in extent about 0.1220 Hectare depicted as Lots A, B andC in the Advance Tracing No. MO/BTT/2015/725 and dated24.06.2016 prepared by the Surveyor- General situated in the ButtalaWedirata Korale Minor Division in the Village of Okkampitiya in theDivisional Secretary's Division of Buttala in Monaragala DistrictUva Province and Bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Elamanaya – Extent: About 0.0619 HectareNorth: Elamanaya claimed by E.A. Anulawathi; East: Elamanayaclaimed by E.A. Anulawathi and canal; South: Canal, Elamanayaclaimed by E.A. Anulawathi and Kumbukkan Oya; West: Elamanayaclaimed by E.A. Anulawathi and Kumbukkan Oya.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Elamanaya – Extent: About 0.0495 HectareNorth: Canal and Elamanaya claimed by E.A. Anulawathi; East:Elamanaya claimed by E.A. Anulawathi and Road; South: Road andElamanaya claimed by E.A. Anulawathi; West: Elamanaya claimedby E.A. Anulawathi and canal.

03. Lot ‘C’ – Elamanaya – Extent: About 0.0106 HectareNorth: Canal and Elamanaya Owners could not be found; East:Elamaya owners could not be found and Road (R.D.A.); South: Road(R.D.A.) and Elamanaya Owners could not be found; West:Elamanaya owners could not be found and canal.
Gayantha Karunatilake,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
